description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The December 2023 AERPAW Find-a-Rover challenge provides 14 datasets from five teams. A UAV measures received signal strength and GPS positions while searching for an unmanned ground vehicle placed at three locations. The experiment uses a 125 kHz waveform and single transmitter and receiver antennas. The collection covers digital-twin development and physical-testbed trials, supporting trajectory optimisation, narrowband propagation modelling and search strategies. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Wireless propagation and UAV search-trajectory optimisation. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
